$comment: Banned phrases for English docs prose. Single source of truth for scripts/lint-prose-en.ts and skills/butler-docs-writing/references/english.md (a test keeps the two in sync). Patterns are case-insensitive. Each example must trigger its own id and no other phrase.

phrases.example: Butler connects seamlessly to the server.

phrases.message: marketing word 'robust'; state the concrete behavior
phrases.example: Butler has a robust retry policy.

phrases.message: marketing word 'powerful'; state the concrete capability
phrases.example: The command palette is a powerful search.
Open Settings in order to add a model.

phrases.pattern: \bworth noting\b|\bimportant to note\b|\bit should be noted\b|\bplease note\b
phrases.message: signpost ('it's worth noting'); state the fact, or use a Notice
phrases.example: It's worth noting that the key stays on this computer.

phrases.message: intensifier ('very', 'really'); delete it or give the number
vague 'various'; name the actual items or delete it
hype word; state the concrete behavior
phrases.example: A comprehensive list of settings follows.

phrases.message: 'not X but Y' framing; say Y
phrases.example: Projects are not only folders but also dashboards.

phrases.message: meta intro ('in this guide', 'let's'); delete it and start with the task
phrases.example: In this guide you add a model.

phrases.message: essay closer ('in summary'); manuals end on the last step
phrases.example: In summary, the model is registered.

phrases.pattern: \bhope this helps\b|\bfeel free to\b|\blet me know\b|\bhappy to help\b|\bgreat question\b
phrases.message: chatbot leftover ('feel free to', 'hope this helps'); delete it
phrases.example: Feel free to change the name.
